topic: Dipped Beam Light Control Interface Specifications

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the parameters and interfaces for controlling the left and right dipped beam lights, specifying the commands (ON/OFF) and unique identifiers for each control instance. It is used to verify that the system correctly interprets and executes commands to turn the dipped beam lights on or off as requested.
